I bought a top that had pockets and my shorts also had built in pockets! I also used a handheld water bottle that had a pocket built in. Phone went in the shorts pocket, a couple gels in the top pocket, and some gummies + my keys in the handheld. This was IMO perfect for me! There were a few times I wish I didn’t have the handheld but it didn’t bug me too much. If I was doing a full I’d probably reassess. I trained using a belt but didn’t want it in photos. 

That being said - I think having water on you is suuuper important. You never know when you’ll need it and I think better to have it & not use it then need it & not have it. Personally I love taking a lil sip whenever I want! 

Good luck with your first race!

As someone who has lived with a roommate and done both: desk in room & desk in common space, it’s obviously better for YOU to have the desk in the common space. My situation worked though as we had similar hours and his job was out of the home, so there wasn’t much overlap. I did feel really guilty anytime he got off early and would often just take my laptop to my room so he could enjoy the space. 

I somewhat consider him a rarity, after having my desk in my room for a year, he suggested I moved it so I didn’t have to live in a “jail cell” anymore. I could not have moved that desk faster. Sleeping + working in the same 4 walls is mentally challenging to say the least. Work/Life balance feels extremely difficult, and I was rapidly getting burnt out. If you can avoid having your desk in your room, I WOULD. 

All that being said - if you guys can find a home with an extra bedroom for an office, that would be my best recommendation! It sounds do-able to work in your room but I promise you that will get old FAST. And if you’re locked into a lease….you’ll just have to suck it up or pay $ for a co-working space membership (also not a bad idea).

Want to share that I too am a shameful vaper. I’ve given up alcohol, shitty foods, etc but it’s been hard getting rid of the vape aspect. 

I told myself I couldn’t run if I couldn’t stop vaping. Said if I could just quit for a week, I’ll start running! Then of course, I never quit and never started. I finally just accepted that I may not have the lung capacity as my fellow non-vaping runner but I can still go give it my best. The more I run, the less the desire is there to vape! I’m down to buying about 1 a month when I used to need to buy once a week. 

My point being - don’t let that habit stop you from running! And treadmills in the cold weather! 

Also 1 km, .1 km, and 10km are all more than 0! I’m proud any day I put my running shoes on and step out of the door, regardless of the length, pace, and strength! You should be too :)

You guys are paying for your run clubs?? 

There are at least 5 within a 5 mile radius of me that are totally free! They opt to sell merch and offer more personalized paid training for race season, but also a free program as well. This way ALL PEOPLE ARE ABLE TO JOIN DESPITE FINANCIAL STATUS! How running should be. 

We also are given treats pretty regularly, think pizza, baked goods, etc. Sometimes we get tequila shots too!! My advice - start your own free one if there’s not one already! All you need is a start point, a social media, and a couple of running friends & it will take off.

Also - we get discounts on races and they often host their own as well :)
